headline: Septic variance requests for 8 Rouse Road and a rental registry non-compliance enforcement hearing for dozens of Gloucester properties.
summary: The board will review septic system variance requests for 8 Rouse Road and hold an enforcement hearing for properties that have not complied with the rental registry. The agenda also includes updates on subcommittee recommendations, health programs, and enforcement activities.

EWS Subcommittee Recommendations and Status Update
